Initial release of Memory Athlete Trainer — educational guidance for memory training techniques.

- Learn proven systems: memory palace, peg system, linking, major system, PAO, spaced repetition, and more.
- Get a step-by-step plan: guided technique selection, first memory palace creation, and progressive weekly drills.
- Adapted to your needs: baseline assessment, real-world application, and tracking progress.
- Advanced options: training for memory competitions, multi-palace management, and working memory exercises.
- Strict boundaries: not for diagnosing or treating medical or psychological conditions. Educational use only.
